correctness.rationale: The universal basis-incidence shattering condition is forest(S) AND connected(G-S), since every partial positive forest extends inside G-(S\P). For K3,n, full columns isolate right vertices, double columns induce parallel or cyclic connections among 3 left vertices, so <=2 pairwise distinct double columns. Complement connectivity holds if some column is empty or singleton columns use >=2 distinct labels. Counting d=0,1,2 double columns yields exactly sum C(n,d)(3)_d z^(2d)[(1+3z)^(n-d)-b_(n-d) z^(n-d)] (b0=1,bk=3 for k>=1). Forest/complement bounds yield VC<=min(n+2,2n-2), and explicit valid choices attain each boundary. The K2,n support complex is rank-(n-1) partition-matroid truncation; for K3,n n>=3 two maximum supports differing in the first two columns violate every basis exchange. Independent direct spanning-tree traces and polynomial coefficients were checked for n=1,2,3.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks are bounded; unrestricted assertions rest on the reconstructed combinatorial proof.
